title: Hidden-World
description: This mod add The Hidden World From HTTYD 3
body: This Mod adds the Hidden World From HTTYD 3 As of Now This Mod Adds The Great Falls witch will spawn in warm ocean biome if you go into it you will be transported to the Hidden world a custom demention were dragon will spawn this mod requires the mod [Book of Dragons](https://modrinth.com/mod/book-of-dragons)
